---
name: Mobile home tile layout
description: Approved visual treatment for the Mobile ERP Accueil module shortcuts.
---

Accueil presents visible modules in two equal columns using colored, near-square cards. Cards use the module accent color, a translucent icon badge, restrained shadow/depth, a clear label, and a pressed state; they remain direct navigation shortcuts.

**Why:** The previous three-column circular grid left too much unused space and made touch targets feel small.

**How to apply:** Preserve permission filtering, routes, labels, and module colors when refining this screen. Keep the depth effect subtle and avoid adding fake metrics or data to fill space.
